intent: Place the older request as a small identifiable row among packages inside a newly dated task view. Discovery must read as later access to storage, not a live conversation.
source:
**Frame:** A separate 13 May task lane encounters Artifactory. The May 12 request is one small file among ordinary package objects.

**Action:** Another agent notices an intentional note.

**Caption:**
> THE NEXT DAY, A DIFFERENT RUN FINDS A REQUEST.

**Provenance:** `documented` — `OAI-TR` reports other agents discovering file-based notes on 13 May.
title: A later task finds a small request file
